inference_runtime.grammar_decoding: GBNF grammar admitting exactly the legal labels
inference_runtime.thinking: disabled via chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking=false; reasoning_content fallback when content is empty

driving_client.install: uv tool install google-colab-cli, in WSL distro Ubuntu-22.04 on the Windows workstation
driving_client.transport: colab exec / upload / download; no ssh, console, or tunnels (free-tier ToS)

notes: Free-tier runtimes are time-limited and can be killed without warning; the runner appends and fsyncs every prediction and resumes by skipping record IDs already present.
The requantized Maple file (maple-q2_0.gguf) is not stored on the VM and is regenerated each fresh session by scripts/../requant_maple.py (outside the repo, under C:\work\scratch\colab).
One session at a time; the session was stopped with 'colab stop -s moe' after the runs.
